description: This file contains functions for generating JSON representations of various metrics related to the 'ofh' (likely 'Open Fronthaul') component, including uplink/downlink metrics, Ethernet metrics, message decoding/encoding, and sector-specific data, with functions for serializing metrics and generating JSON strings.

methods.name: generate_received_messages
methods.description: Generates JSON for received message metrics, including total, early, on-time, late, and message timing in microseconds.

methods.name: generate_ethernet_rx
methods.description: Generates JSON for Ethernet receiver metrics, including throughput, latency, and CPU usage.

methods.name: generate_message_decoder_item
methods.description: Generates JSON for message decoding performance metrics.

methods.name: generate_message_decoder
methods.description: Generates JSON for overall message decoding performance, including prach and data processing metrics, and ECPRI message stats.

methods.name: generate_uplink
methods.description: Generates JSON for uplink metrics, including received messages, Ethernet metrics, message decoder, and window stats.

methods.name: generate_ethernet_tx
methods.description: Generates JSON for Ethernet transmitter metrics.

methods.name: generate_tx_data_flow
methods.description: Generates JSON for data flow performance metrics.

methods.name: generate_message_encoder
methods.description: Generates JSON for message encoder metrics.

methods.name: generate_message_transmitter
methods.description: Generates JSON for message transmitter metrics.

methods.name: generate_transmitter_statistics
methods.description: Generates JSON for transmitter late slot/request statistics.

methods.name: generate_downlink
methods.description: Generates JSON for downlink metrics, including Ethernet, message encoder, message transmitter, and stats.

methods.name: generate_ofh_cell
methods.description: Generates JSON for a sector's OFH cell metrics, including PCI, uplink, and downlink data.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main function to generate comprehensive JSON report for 'ofh' metrics, including timestamp, RU, and sector data.

methods.name: generate_string
methods.description: Converts the generated JSON report into a formatted string with optional indentation.
